    Linearity and dimensions for the Morita functor #

    For a k-algebra A and an idempotent e, the coinduction functor Morita.functor e : Mod eAe ⥤ Mod A is k-linear. If ∑ᵢ₌₁ⁿ aᵢ e bᵢ = 1, then dim M ≤ dim Hom_C(eA, M) ≤ n · dim M (le_dim, dim_le); hence the functor preserves finite-dimensionality and the dimension of every infinite-dimensional module, as in the proof of Lemma 3.1.
